THE CLOCK of ONTOLOGY01.pdf: Existence moves — but only if you know its hidden geometry. The Clock of Ontology does not study what exists — it maps how existence moves. Being, Meaning, civilizations, and individuals all follow a hidden geometry of motion: they rise, decay, and sometimes, escape. Modern life is not false. It is collapsed — detached from virtue, meaning, and alignment. Institutions thrive while producing decay, not through corruption, but through a reduced structure. This book reveals the ontic regions of order, blindness, decay, and resurrection. Mythologies are not mere stories — they are early maps of the same geometry, pointing the way to a third dimension of being: Flight, achievable only through precise alignment with Meaning (Logos). No preaching. No persuasion. No invented values. Only the structure of existence, waiting to be seen.
